reason: Fixed potential infinite loop issue in FLASH_WaitForLastOperation. The function contains a while loop that waits for FLASH hardware flags (__HAL_FLASH_GET_FLAG) which would cause infinite blocking in emulation without real hardware. Modified to skip the hardware flag waiting loop while preserving timeout checking logic. This allows the emulation to proceed without getting stuck waiting for hardware flags that will never change in the emulated environment. Also removed hardware-specific flag clearing and error checking operations.
